name: @dsh-external/dsh-route-boost
description: DSH host-plane route booster for the nine security presets: infers the current (mode, phase) from the latest user message (sticky phase memory) and re-injects a compact governance envelope — gate checklist (from dsh-stage-gate GATES), review/double-sign reminder, boundary line, evidence-level pre-judgment, refs pointers or a forced-search nudge on miss — as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. A new snapshot lands only when the envelope text CHANGES (RuntimeContextProjection dedupes), so steady phases cost nothing.
author: SeaOf0
